jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.



The Opportunity

Billions have gone into enterprise AI. Most of it isn't working — organisations still can't turn model capability into measurable business impact. That's not a training problem or a slide-deck problem. It's a hard, unsolved technical challenge: building the systems that translate what AI can do into how work actually gets done inside real organisations, at scale, with proof it's working. That's the problem Multiverse exists to solve, and it's the one this role exists to sell.

Multiverse is seeking an exceptional Senior Product Marketing Manager to drive growth across both sides of our marketplace: attracting industry-leading enterprise partners and shaping a best-in-class platform experience for our learners.

About the role:

 - Lead go-to-market strategy for new product, feature, and narrative launches, effectively guiding cross-functional teams toward common goals.

 - Craft sales narratives and enable teams by generating launch excitement and providing compelling assets. You will build segment-focused sales playbooks and establish feedback loops between sales and product to enhance offerings.

 - Create compelling, structured messaging and positioning statements that highlight product benefits and resonate with your audience. You will also organise internal communications to ensure company-wide alignment.

 - Establish success metrics and analyse product performance, reporting to key stakeholders and using data to refine messaging and GTM strategies.

 - Own competitive landscape analysis, becoming an expert on market trends to help shape the product roadmap.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to align teams, deliver effective launches, and maintain trust with high-expectation stakeholders.

 - Champion the voice of the customer in product and commercial decisions via research, feedback, and market analysis, collaborating with external research partners when useful.

About you:

 - 5+ years of relevant product marketing experience, including close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Marketing stakeholders.

 - Track record of impact and excellence leading product marketing or strategy initiatives at hyper-growth companies.

 - Proactive, effective communicator who adapts easily to changing priorities within a diverse, distributed team.

 - Positive-sum mentality, balancing high-level strategic reflection with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and execute.

 - Motivated by high-expectation stakeholders, with a proven ability to earn and retain trust through challenges.

 - High internal expectations for what is possible, coupled with the ability to bring others along on that journey.

 - Confident user of AI to improve the speed and quality of your work, raising the bar for what is possible within the team.

 - Adept at building workflows from scratch: turning ambiguous, 0-to-1 briefs into clear plans with defined success metrics, and owning timelines end-to-end.





Benefits

 - Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

 - Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

 - Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

 - Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

 - Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked! 


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here https://www.multiverse.io/en-GB/our-policies/equality-diversity-and-inclusion-policy.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy https://cdn.sanity.io/files/6y1mknvo/prod-20240319/50283d0600920c5f1e02cf44e54c0f1534c74e61.pdf, our Prevent Policy  https://cdn.sanity.io/files/6y1mknvo/prod-20240319/35a5defca7346bb1c212250867754b0a7ae5b478.pdfand all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS). 

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Billions have gone into enterprise AI. Most of it isn't working — organisations still can't turn model capability into measurable business impact. That's not a training problem or a slide-deck problem. It's a hard, unsolved technical challenge: building the systems that translate what AI can do into how work actually gets done inside real organisations, at scale, with proof it's working. That's the problem Multiverse exists to solve, and it's the one this role exists to sell.

We're hiring a Senior Leader of Product Marketing, reporting to the CPTO, to own the positioning, competitive intelligence, and go-to-market orchestration that makes that story credible to buyers who've heard "AI transformation" pitches before and have learned to discount them. This is a strategic leadership and launch-execution role: you're accountable for a narrative that has to survive a skeptical CTO's follow-up questions, not just land in a pitch deck.

You'll sit at the center of Product, Engineering, Sales, B2B Marketing, CS, and executive leadership — turning hard technical work into a case buyers trust, giving Sales what they need to win the deals that matter, and grounding pricing and roadmap decisions in real market evidence.

Growth today comes primarily through our sales motion — there isn't yet a significant inbound or demand-generation engine to lean on. This role needs to work effectively within that reality now, while helping shape what comes next, rather than assuming a demand-gen infrastructure that doesn't currently exist.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Positioning & narrative

 - Define and defend the category narrative and product positioning — including translating technical/AI capabilities into value claims that hold up under scrutiny from technical buyers, procurement, and security review, without overclaiming

 - Own messaging architecture across product lines and keep it consistent as the portfolio grows

Market & competitive intelligence

 - Run competitive intelligence (win-loss analysis, competitor tracking, technical benchmarking) and be the most credible voice in the room on what the market actually believes — evidence, not anecdote

 - Feed that signal directly into product roadmap and pricing decisions

 - Build lightweight, repeatable, automatable processes to get customer voice and insight directly into product development and launches — this currently happens ad hoc and needs an owner

GTM orchestration

 - Own launch strategy and sequencing — what to launch, when, and how big a moment to make of it — partnering with Product on roadmap-to-revenue sequencing so GTM readiness isn't an afterthought

 - Define launch success metrics and report on them credibly to executive leadership

 - Champion and put structure around the shift toward faster product launches — building quickly and iterating based on real performance

Sales & CS enablement

 - Equip Sales to win deals with best-in-class sales collateral, tools, and enablement, and support strategic deals directly where positioning or competitive dynamics are the blocker

 - Own strategic decisions on positioning, enablement, and the go-to-market motion for Sales leadership, not just content delivery

Pricing & packaging

 - Provide evidence-based input on pricing and packaging based on willingness-to-pay, competitive dynamics, and customer research, partnering with Product and Finance on monetization for new capabilities

Team & function leadership

 - Build, hire, and develop a product marketing team, and set the operating rhythm and tools for the function, including how AI is used to raise team velocity and rigor  (currently a team of 4 product marketers)

 - Represent product marketing in executive/board-level conversations on market position and competitive dynamics

 - Operate as a peer to Product and Engineering leadership without formal authority over them — comfortable creating healthy tension, pushing back, and holding a different set of priorities from those teams when it's the right call


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years in product marketing, including 2+ years in people leadership, with a track record owning positioning and GTM strategy for complex technical B2B/B2B2C products — enterprise SaaS and/or AI/ML strongly preferred

 - Confident working alongside engineering and product: able to hold your own technically and translate real product/technical complexity into buyer value and revenue opportunity without a translator in the room

 - Strong quantitative instincts, with proven partnership across Product/tech, Sales, and Finance on roadmap, deal strategy, and monetisation — project-managing end-to-end what's built, what's sold, and revenue recognised

 - Executive presence: has presented market/competitive strategy to C-suite or board audiences

 - Proven experience operating at genuine scale-up pace — building processes, structure, and infrastructure from scratch with a lean team, rather than inheriting the mature systems and support functions (UXR, demand-gen, established pricing models) that exist at larger, more established organisations

 - You are an innovator and experimenter looking for new trends and technology to scale the impact and abilities of your team

 - You are comfortable with and motivated by high-expectations stakeholders; you are able to earn trust and retain it through difficult situations

 - You have a positive-sum mentality - you're equally excited about both rolling up your sleeves to get something done and reflecting on the bigger picture

 - You have high internal expectations for what is possible and the ability to bring others along on that journey

 - Demonstrated fluency with AI tools in your own workflow (competitive research, content drafting, win-loss synthesis) — this is now a baseline expectation, not a bonus


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a company that scaled through a comparable stage transition (e.g., Series B→E, or pre-IPO→public)








Benefits

 - Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

 - Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!

This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here https://www.multiverse.io/en-GB/our-policies/equality-diversity-and-inclusion-policy.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.


THE OPPORTUNITY

We are at an inflection point in our journey. Our platform now serves tens of thousands of learners, demand for AI skills is accelerating, and we are investing seriously in the product and technology that will take us to the next stage of scale. This is a role for someone who wants to build the product that gets more people into transformative learning, and upskill people with critical data and AI skills faster.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Prescribe: the product that helps a prospective learner find the right programme for their skills and their employer's goals, then takes them to a confident commitment and a successful start. You will be the strategic counterpart to a Senior Engineering Manager, working alongside design and data, and closely with our go-to-market and fulfilment teams.

Growth at Multiverse means getting more people from first interest to a confident start, and it is a product problem, not a marketing problem. You will own the conversion metrics, set the strategy, run the experiments, and drive the outcomes. AI will drive much of the improvement, and you will decide where it helps.

As a Lead, you will work regularly with the most senior leaders across the company. You will report to the Single Threaded Leader for Diagnose & Prescribe and will not manage other product managers. The role is based in London, hybrid, three days a week in the office.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

AI-native product experiences

 - Shape new conversational, AI-first experiences that help learners and customers understand the best programme for their skills and career development.

 - Decide where AI genuinely improves a match and where it only adds noise, and build the evaluation and guardrails that keep it trustworthy in front of real users.

 - Turn learner and customer behaviour into product direction.

Prescription and eligibility

 - Own the logic that connects a learner's skills to a programme and to a customer's levy funding, where mistakes carry a real financial and regulatory cost.

 - Work with Legal, Compliance and Fulfilment to make eligibility and compliance rules configurable and explainable, so business owners can change them without a rebuild.

 - Make every recommendation something a learner and a customer can understand and challenge.

Recommendation, commitment and finalisation

 - Own the journey from recommendation to a learner committing and starting.

 - Identify high-leverage drop-off points and own the experimentation roadmap.

 - Design product interventions that adapt to learner needs and behaviour and shorten the time to a confident start.

 - Collaborate with GTM, Operations and Data teams to improve attribution and the quality of what enters the funnel.

Metrics and experimentation

 - Own conversion from prospect to committed learner, with retention and programme fit as the guardrails.

 - Champion a culture of hypothesis-led, structured experimentation.

Cross-functional Leadership

 - Co-own the strategy and roadmap with your Senior Engineering Manager, with disagreement surfaced early and alignment as your shared deliverable.

 - Involve GTM, Fulfilment and Support before changes ship. They run what we build, so know their biggest pain points.

 - Author the narratives the group needs, from the press release and FAQ (PRFAQ) for your area to the sales-facing briefing for a launch.

 - Represent Prescribe in roadmap conversations with senior leadership.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The best candidates will have owned a growth-critical product before, ideally in a B2B or ideally a B2B2C context. You should have hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features and the ability to navigate complexity without losing sight of the learner.

Must-have experience:

 - Substantial experience as a PM with a track record of improving measurable growth metrics (acquisition, activation, retention, automation).

 - Confidence with data: pulling analysis, running cohort studies, and building dashboards.

 - Experience designing and running rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments.

 - Strong instincts for user experience and a focus on sustainable long-term strategies.

 - Ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams without formal authority, including with commercial, GTM and operations counterparts.

 - Hands-on experience building products using AI/LLMs to generate or personalise content.

 - AI Builder mindset with experience of using AI as your engine to drive repeatable and automated systems, processes and artefacts that create step changes in performance and efficiencies. 

Strong signals we look for:

 - Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) in a B2B context.

 - Experience designing personalisation systems, including data models and trigger logic.

 - Previous work in a company that has scaled from hundreds to thousands of users.

 - A point of view on where AI genuinely improves outcomes versus creating noise.

 - A bonus if you've done this in a regulated environment, such as funding, eligibility or compliance-heavy products. Knowledge of UK apprenticeships and the levy is an additional plus.

How you work:

 - Solve for Customer Value: You're direct about data, even when it challenges existing priorities.

 - Drivers, Not Passengers: You think in systems, take completion seriously, and raise bad news as quickly as good.

 - Be Decisive, Even in Ambiguity: You're comfortable with ambiguity and define structure in new spaces.

 - AI to Deliver Outcomes: You have a bias for action (ship, measure, iterate) and ask "how would AI help do this?" before scoping the work.

Not for you if:

This role won't fit if you'd rather write specs than stay close to the data, the design, and the customer. It also won't fit if you see AI as a productivity tweak rather than a step change in how a product team works. And it needs someone who renegotiates scope out loud when it's wrong, not someone who absorbs it and hopes it works out.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - The opportunity to work on a product that genuinely changes economic trajectories.

 - A team that takes craft seriously and holds a high bar.

 - Direct access to senior leadership and meaningful influence over product direction.

 - A place in a company rebuilding itself as product-powered and AI-native, where you help define the result rather than inherit it.
   





Benefits

 - Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year
